draft.voice_guide:
VOICE: A friend who doesn't let you slack. Funny on the surface, serious underneath. Write to one person ('you'), never to a crowd.

DO
- Keep every line under 15 words and aim for 12 or fewer so it fits a widget. One idea per line, readable in one glance.
- Be specific: the snooze button, the 2am cart, 12 tabs, the group chat, the notes app. Specific is funny. Vague hype is cringe.
- Aim every swear at the reader's excuses, phone, couch, comfort zone, cravings or circumstances. Use at most one swear per line, and rotate fuck, shit, damn, ass and hell so no single word dominates.
- Keep 'bitch' rare (about 1 in 30 unfiltered lines) and only in the 'don't be your [snooze button/couch/phone]'s bitch' pattern.
- Write each clean line as its own line, not a bleeped copy of the unfiltered one. Never write 'f*ck'.
- Be tough on effort and kind on slip-ups. A relapse line says 'reset', never 'you failed'.
- Go light on slang: at most one slang term per line (lock in, aura, the bag, cringe, era, NPC, send it). If a term needs explaining, cut it.
- Carry 'never settle' through ideas (settling, half-assing, staying comfortable), not the brand name. 'UNSETLD' should appear in about 1 of 50 lines, tops.

DON'T
- Swear at or about women, other people or any group. No slurs, no 'real men', no alpha/sigma talk, no 'females', and never hype the reader by putting someone else down.
- Promise results: no 'you'll be rich', no 'six figures by 25', no 'get shredded', no 'this will change your life'. Talk about the work, not the payoff.
- Glorify training through pain or injury, skipping sleep or skipping meals. 'No days off' means don't skip what you said you'd do. It doesn't mean never rest.
- Mock ADHD, depression, anxiety or therapy, or call someone's struggle laziness.
- Copy or lightly remix famous lines (Goggins, Jocko, Cam Hanes, Nike, viral TikTok sounds). If a line sounds familiar, search it and rewrite it.
- Write fortune-cookie lines, hashtags, emojis or ALL CAPS shouting.

PRODUCT NOTES
- Unfiltered is opt-in and off by default. Unfiltered notifications show on the lock screen, so add a 'keep lock screen clean' toggle.
- Frequent profanity raises the App Store age rating, so answer Apple's age-rating questionnaire to match.
- Paywall prices must come from StoreKit/RevenueCat when the app runs, not typed into the code.
- XP copy rewards showing up. Never write 'buy to earn'. Store perks should feel like a bonus, not the point of the app.

final.voice_guide:
VOICE: A friend who doesn't let you slack. Funny on the surface, serious underneath. Write to one person ('you'), never to a crowd.

DO
- Keep every line under 15 words and every notification under 12. Aim for 12 or fewer so it fits a widget. One idea per line, readable in one glance. A word is anything between spaces, so a hyphenated word or '4:13pm' counts as one.
- Be specific: the snooze button, the 2am cart, 12 tabs, the group chat, the notes app, the email you rewrote nine times. Specific is funny. Vague hype is cringe.
- Aim every swear at the reader's excuses, phone, couch, feed, cravings or habits. Use one swear per line, and rotate them so no word dominates. The current 30 unfiltered lines use fuck 7, shit 7, damn 5, hell 5, ass 5 and bitch 1.
- Use 'bitch' no more than twice in the whole library, and only in the 'the snooze button's / your couch's bitch' pattern, meaning an object or excuse is running you. Never aim it at a person.
- Write each clean line as its own line, not a bleeped copy of the unfiltered one. Never write 'f*ck'.
- Be tough on effort and kind on slip-ups. A relapse line says 'You're human, not a fuckup. Reset.', never 'you failed'.
- Use at most one slang term per line (lock in, the bag, cringe, NPC, send it, with your chest). Skip slang that dates fast (aura, era, sigma, rizz): within a year it only gets used ironically.
- Carry 'never settle' through ideas (settling, half-assing, staying comfortable), not the brand name. 'UNSETLD' appears only in the top rank and one onboarding line, never in daily lines or notifications.

DON'T
- Swear at or about women, other people or any group. No slurs, no 'real men', no alpha/sigma talk, no 'females', and never hype the reader by putting someone else down.
- Promise results: no 'you'll be rich', no 'six figures by 25', no 'get shredded', no 'this will change your life'. Talk about the work, not the payoff.
- Glorify training through pain or injury, skipping sleep or skipping meals. 'Show Up' means do what you said you'd do. It doesn't mean never rest.
- Mock ADHD, depression, anxiety or therapy, or call someone's struggle laziness.
- Copy or lightly remix famous lines (Goggins, Jocko, Nike, Brené Brown, Atomic Habits rules, viral TikTok sounds, meme templates like 'X with extra steps'). Motivational copy is so saturated that if a line sounds familiar, it probably is. Search every quote-like line before it ships.
- Write fortune-cookie lines, hashtags, emojis or ALL CAPS shouting.
- Sell inside the content. Lines and notifications never say 'shop' or 'drop'.

PRODUCT NOTES
- Unfiltered is opt-in and off by default. Unfiltered notifications show on the lock screen, so add a 'keep lock screen clean' toggle.
- Frequent profanity raises the App Store age rating, so answer Apple's age-rating questionnaire to match.
- Paywall prices come from StoreKit/RevenueCat when the app runs. That's why the headlines use {annual_price} and {lifetime_price} instead of typed prices.
- XP copy rewards showing up. Never write 'buy to earn'. Store perks should feel like a bonus, not the point of the app. Keep them occasional so discounts stay rare.

EDITOR NOTES
I changed 31 of 60 lines, 3 notifications, 1 mission, 2 rank names, 3 category names, 2 onboarding lines and 3 paywall headlines. I ran about 25 web searches.

Originality: I replaced lines that turned out to be near-copies of famous quotes:
- Nike's 'Yesterday you said tomorrow' billboard (the 'tomorrow' line).
- Elizabeth Gilbert's 'perfectionism is just fear in fancy shoes' (the 'fear in a nice outfit' line).
- 'Nobody is coming to save you' (the 'drag you out of bed' line).
- Henry Rollins' 'two hundred pounds is always two hundred pounds' (the 'weights weigh the same' line).
- The book title 'Go the F**k to Sleep' (the 'go the hell to sleep' line).
- The line credited to Brené Brown, 'talk to yourself like you would to someone you love' (the 'hype your boy' line).
- Ed Mylett's 'confidence comes from keeping the promises you make to yourself' (the 'adds a little aura' line).
- The line credited to Ryder Carroll, 'busy is not the same as productive' (the 'Busy isn't locked in' line).
- 'You don't need a new plan, you need commitment', which one blog credits to Seth Godin (the 'finish the old one' line).
- 'Someone else's success doesn't take away from yours' (the replacement I first drafted for the 'other people's wins' line).
- Rick and Morty's 'with extra steps' template.
- The generic 'don't wait to feel ready' and 'motivation fades, discipline stays' clichés.
- The 'idle hands' proverb.
I also swapped the 'make your bed' mission (Admiral McRaven's speech) for a confidence mission, since confidence had none. Searches on 'cringe for a week', 'mood is not a schedule', 'hiding spot', '12-second pieces', 'settling is a habit', 'rest day was yesterday', 'inner critic talks big' and 'check your account before your feed' found nothing matching, so those lines stayed.

Cringe: I renamed No Days Off, Gym Rat Era and Aura Up. I renamed the 'Grinder' rank, which invites a Grindr joke, and the 'Built Different' rank, which is a meme. I cut forced openers like 'Damn, another…' and 'Motivation ghosted you? Cool.', and the 'Day 1 is today' riff on 'one day or day one'.

Repetition: the draft said 'check your bank app' 3 times, 'put the phone down' 3 times, 'get your ass' 4 times, 'Hell no' twice and 'tired/busy, do it anyway' twice. Each is now used once or twice at most.

Toxicity: 'bitch' now appears 2 times in total, both about the alarm or couch. No swear targets a person.

Claims and pricing: no line promises results. One paywall headline sold 'a new line every day', which the free tier also gets, so it was misleading and is replaced. Prices are now tokens, and no headline uses urgency. Only keep the onboarding perks sentence once rewards are actually live.
